diaryPrompts: What did you do today? Write at least five sentences.
What are your plans for tonight? (Örnek: I will be helping a customer remotely at 8 pm.)
What did you learn today? Use one new word from your dictionary.
Describe your day using the simple past tense.
What will you do tomorrow? Use 'will' or 'be going to'.
Write about a problem you solved this week.
What would you do if you had a free day? Use 'would'.
Who did you talk to today and what did you talk about?
What are you working on these days? Use the present continuous.
Write three things you are grateful for and why.
